rule: Ten rated Task10 boards with zero key glyphs visible at start, family≥8, no frozen keys and both keys taken before the clock. Balance stories, then distinct puzzle structures, then lowest full family score and id. Six family campaigns each; unchanged profile/bot. Existing main-sample families may reuse their first two exact streams.

card.sentence: The clock is locked; the keys sit on the other island.
bites: The clock needs 15 moves and gets 16: 1 to spare.
2 tiles you must take on the way wait in the tray until after the clock: whatever the order, the tray reaches 3.
On the way the tray fills to 3, 4 moves with 3 waiting.
1 dig uncover a face-down tile while 2 wait (luck).

intents.name: honest clock: real fewest moves 15 + spare 1
tray reaches exactly 3 on the fewest way to the clock
intents.detail: max 3, moves with 3 waiting 4; forced on every way in time: yes

intents.name: moves with 3 waiting on the way: 3 (within 1)
at least 1 face-down tiles on the dig
no free cruising: the clock not in the last third, the tray busy in the first half
intents.detail: clock at move 15 of 76; 2 waiting first at move 2
